title: Pulse dashboard polish: unpin toast + sparkline persistence + remove dead reload_pins
description:
From GH issue thedouglenz/cruster#4. Three small dashboard nits, all in DashboardView (same module — keep as one PR to avoid rebase churn).

Nit 1: pressing 'x' (unpin) is silent. Add toast 'unpinned: <kind/ns/name>' mirroring the existing pin toast. Use the same pending-toast mechanism as pending_prompt_trigger / pending_export, or add a take_pending_toast trait method.

Nit 2: per-pin sparklines reset every dashboard visit because view_for_id constructs a fresh DashboardView. Cheapest fix: cache the dashboard view in App (change current_view to enum { Dashboard(DashboardView), Other(Box<dyn ResourceView>) } or similar). Disk persistence and background-task options are overkill for v1.

Nit 3: DashboardView::reload_pins is defined but never called. If Nit 2 picks option (a), wire it up; otherwise delete it.

Acceptance:
- Pressing 'x' on a pin shows a toast naming the unpinned resource
- Dashboard -> pods -> dashboard preserves per-pin sparkline history within a session
- reload_pins either deleted or has a real caller
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings stays clean
- Existing dashboard tests pass; ideally a new test covers unpin-toast and sparkline-persistence
